import { KrdsElement } from '../base.js';
import { FormControlController } from '../../controllers/form-control-controller.js';
/** Native Shadow DOM button; bridges activation to the host's external form. */
export declare class Button extends KrdsElement {
    static formAssociated: boolean;
    static properties: {
        type: {
            type: StringConstructor;
        };
        disabled: {
            type: BooleanConstructor;
            reflect: boolean;
        };
        name: {
            type: StringConstructor;
            reflect: boolean;
        };
        value: {
            type: StringConstructor;
        };
        variant: {
            type: StringConstructor;
        };
        size: {
            type: StringConstructor;
        };
    };
    type: 'button' | 'submit' | 'reset';
    disabled: boolean;
    name: string;
    value: string;
    variant: string;
    size: string;
    readonly formControl: FormControlController;
    constructor();
    get form(): HTMLFormElement | null;
    resetControl(): void;
    restoreControl(): void;
    formDisabledCallback(value: boolean): void;
    formResetCallback(): void;
    formStateRestoreCallback(): void;
    private activate;
    render(): import("lit").TemplateResult<1>;
}
